purpose: Paired calibration report identifies versions, sample counts/uncertainty and challenge trend; indistinguishable levels remain an explicit tuning failure

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Paired calibration report identifies versions, sample counts/uncertainty and challenge trend; indistinguishable levels remain an explicit tuning failure
setup: Pin immutable candidate/baseline source, map/content/profile versions and ordinary legal starts
Predeclare 20 paired seeds plus disjoint holdout, side/faction swaps and three 60-minute simulation soaks
actions: At the later authorized gate execute equal paired workloads for each difficulty
Build an offline report from authoritative terminal/recovery outcomes with exact sample denominators
measurements: Per-seed outcome and challenge metrics, confidence/uncertainty, baseline adapter identity and actual sample counts
Soak bounded-state and gameplay outcome evidence separately from short-match calibration
required: Report exposes whether difficulty ordering changes challenge with uncertainty
Indistinguishable levels remain an explicit tuning failure rather than a manufactured trend
forbidden: Claiming one run establishes difficulty ordering

workloads.calibration: Use existing declared pairedRuns/holdoutSeeds/difficultyPairs/opponentProfiles/mapLabels without silently substituting defaults.
workloads.soakPolicy: 50 ms ticks make 72000 ticks sixty simulation minutes per soak. Three separate complete legal-start matches; retain full meaningful bounded-state and outcome evidence, not just a terminal tick. A match ending before 72000 ticks is a shorter terminal sample, not proof of a sixty-minute soak; never silently count it toward that denominator.

capabilityLimits: D-06 dispatches tools/ai/run-difficulty-calibration.mjs, not the generic per-variant runner. Six faction/phase descriptors expand the frozen difficulty-calibration-v1.json workload; they are not six physical matches.

Twenty predeclared seed cells cover both maps/factions and all five fixed native opponent openings, both sides and all three policies. Up to80 disjoint reserved seeds extend uncertain comparisons; five disjoint holdout seeds are never used for tuning.

Each revision builds in its own detached checkout with its own lockfile. The pinned legacy adapter exposes only native legal starts, commands/world hash and final metrics; its missing new difficulty/opening policies remain an explicit unsupported comparison, never a pass or candidate fallback.

Three separate72000-tick soaks must actually reach that boundary. Short terminal matches do not count as hour-long evidence. Native correctness, fairness, challenge uncertainty and unsupported baseline policies remain separate verdicts.

Opaque traces stay local; per-match artifacts are capped128KiB and the model-facing summary8192 UTF-8 bytes. No calibration, build, install, server or browser execution has run during registration authoring.
